name: Dawson Tull
source_profile: ● Dawson Tull (NE) is the Overland's principal right-of-way agent, responsible for acquiring land and negotiating construction agreements. He is notorious for employing intimidation, questionable deeds, and hired muscle to secure valuable crossings and routes. Tull considers the removal of uncooperative homesteaders a regrettable but necessary expense of doing business.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 42 (source excerpt; may be partial)
